_comment: Placeholders are declared, not discovered. The loader refuses a resource
containing an undeclared placeholder, and the validator refuses a packet
in which any placeholder survived. Both directions matter: an undeclared
placeholder means the renderer does not know to fill it, and a surviving
placeholder means a literal {brace} shipped to the model.
The legacy application had three constants that had to agree about the
same variation count. They disagreed twice in one day and the second
disagreement shipped: a packet asked for four sections and then ordered
the model to produce five. Declaring the contract here is what makes that
